reasoning: Shows an open box or tray with a bent arrow pointing outward, standard UI iconography for sharing, forwarding, or exporting. While abstract and action-oriented, it fits real tasks centered on data export, file extraction, or forwarding items when no specific physical object dominates. It can be confused with external-link, upload, or log-out icons.
